title: I texted what I wanted. It built it. Pictures and a clip came back.
body: I texted: a queue app for a bakery. Short bubbles, then photos of the two ways, then a video of the one it picked. A PR was already open with the same files. I did not have to say yes to start.

title: The PR had the video. So did iMessage.
body: I sent a GitHub PR URL. Two lines: hardcoded key in auth.py:18. Then a screenshot bubble, then a clip. The same files were on the PR. I said nothing. The comment still went up with the pictures.

title: It used the app the way I would. It did not nag.
body: I don't have extra apps. It used the product like I would, sent photos and a short clip, and did not ask me to install anything. A friend with a Mac got the same pass there, no tap-for-permission ritual.

title: It learned how I write. No form.
body: I said my name in Portuguese, short. It asked what I wanted to make. After that it answered like me. I never filled a form.

title: Falei em português. Bolhas curtas. Foto e vídeo.
body: Mandei o que eu queria. Duas linhas por bolha, várias bolhas. Depois as fotos, depois o vídeo. Na língua em que eu escrevi.
